C. I. D.
I. D. REG
No. 292
Date 29/4/16.

Shanghai Municipal Council.

April 29th 1916.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
An alleged rebel named Colonel Waung Tsung Zung 黄镇情
was arrested at the S.N.Railway Station at 11 p.m. on the
27th inst on his arrival from Nanking.

At 6 a.m. on the 28th inst 1000 Government troops
arrived at Changchow and 500 arrived at Wusieh at 9 a.m.
the same date.

At 6 a.m. this morning 1500 Government troops arrived
at Shanghai from Nanking. Of these 1200 will be stationed
at Woosung and the remainder outside the south gate of the City.

The strike of skin trunk makers is still going on.
They held a meeting in the Joh Yeu teashop Rue de Consulate
in Frenchtown yesterday but there are no signs of an agreement
being reached. The strike is being conducted very quietly.

Your Obedient Servant,
[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事调查处
身份登记
编号 292
日期 1916年4月29日

上海工部局

1916年4月29日

（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

先生：

一名涉嫌叛乱分子、名为黄镇情上校（Colonel Waung Tsung Zung）的男子，于本月27日晚11时自南京抵达上海北站（S.N. Railway Station）时被捕。

本月28日上午6时，1000名政府军抵达常州；同日上午9时，500名政府军抵达无锡。

今日上午6时，1500名政府军自南京抵达上海。其中1200人将驻防吴淞，其余人员驻防于县城南门外。

皮箱匠的罢工仍在继续。他们昨日在法租界领事馆路（Rue de Consulate）的聚友茶馆（Joh Yeu teashop）举行集会，但尚无达成协议的迹象。此次罢工进行得十分平静。

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长

警务处总监
